description: Desktop 1280x720: reload the page and assert the emulated metrics. A navigation restores the override that 00 applied before the first navigation. Used in s6 after REA calls and after Playwright screenshots; the drift seen there (headless default screen 800x600) was traced to Playwright's page.screenshot(), which the driver no longer uses. This reload is not a persistence observation: what scenario 06's reload restored is in behaviour B-30, and what else a reload keeps is not observed (R-54).
